description.default: Edit SiYuan's own list blocks as an outline or a mindmap. Nodes ARE native list items — no custom attributes, no private storage, no second copy of your data. Everything stays searchable and fully editable after the plugin is uninstalled.
description.zh_CN: 用大纲 / 导图视图编辑思源原生块。节点就是思源列表项本身 —— 不写自定义属性、不用私有存储、不产生第二份数据。卸载插件后文档照常可搜索、可编辑。
